diagnostic.root_cause: L-BFGS time_weight increase from 2.0 to 2.3 pushes optimizer to find shorter segment times, reducing trajectory time 13.69→13.47s. ILC partially compensates but gate-4 and gate-7 (S-turn exit and helix entry) exceed 0.25m per-gate threshold due to faster approach speeds.
architectural_issues: Gate-4 at 0.302m — exceeded aspirational 0.25m threshold. L-BFGS compresses gate-4 approach segments the most.
Gate-7 at 0.252m — barely over aspirational threshold. Helix entry is consistently the hardest tracking point.
Gate-8 at 0.240m — close to threshold. Helix interior tracking degrades with faster trajectory.
L-BFGS landscape is highly non-convex — time_weight=2.2 finds worse minimum than 2.3. Unreliable for further tuning.
TOPP acceleration budget changes catastrophically destabilize ILC — ILC is tightly coupled to trajectory shape.
Actuator saturation (roll/pitch at 0.85 rad cap) approaches physical limit — average thrust at 0.870.

improvements_backlog.description: Gate-4 and gate-7 ILC improvement to recover tracking quality
improvements_backlog.proposed_approach: Extend inflection section to cover gate-4 (inflection_end 440→460). Increase helix section max_correction 0.45→0.50m. Re-tune vel_scale for new trajectory speeds.

improvements_backlog.description: Further targeted inflation reduction at gates with headroom
improvements_backlog.proposed_approach: Reduce helix entry 1.06→1.03, helix interior 1.05→1.03. Target segments serving gates 1, 9, 10, 11 which have >0.1m headroom.

improvements_backlog.description: L-BFGS multi-start optimization to avoid bad minima
improvements_backlog.proposed_approach: Run L-BFGS from 3-5 random perturbations of initial times. Select trajectory with best sim score. Graduated time_weight: start 2.0→optimize→restart at 2.5 from previous solution.
improvements_backlog.expected_impact: Could unlock time_weight=2.5+ safely, potentially 13.0s race time

improvements_backlog.description: Re-tune velocity correction scaling for time_weight=2.3 trajectory
improvements_backlog.proposed_approach: Velocity profile changed with new time_weight. Current vel_scale (0.0/0.4/0.5/0.7) was tuned for old profile. Try 0.0/0.3/0.4/0.6 or 0.0/0.5/0.6/0.8.

failed_approaches.description: Increased max_velocity from 10.0 to 12.0 AND initial time allocation from 0.6 to 0.7 simultaneously. Trajectory became too aggressive for kinematic sim PD controller.
failed_approaches.lesson: Match trajectory aggressiveness to controller capability. Change one parameter at a time.

failed_approaches.description: Curvature-aware initial time allocation had no measurable impact because L-BFGS optimizer re-optimizes times regardless of initial guess.
failed_approaches.lesson: Initial time allocation heuristic matters less than the optimizer that runs after it.
failed_approaches.reason: L-BFGS masks initial allocation differences

failed_approaches.description: transition_time = max(times[i], times[i+1]) for acceleration estimation at segment boundaries.
failed_approaches.lesson: The acceleration estimate at segment boundaries serves as a feasibility proxy. Modifying it causes divergence.
failed_approaches.reason: Optimizer produced trajectories too fast for kinematic sim to follow

failed_approaches.description: transition_time = avg(times[i], times[i+1]) for acceleration estimation.
failed_approaches.lesson: Both max and average transition_time variants cause the same problem.
failed_approaches.reason: Still too aggressive

failed_approaches.description: time_weight = 3.0 with original acceleration estimate.
failed_approaches.lesson: Increasing time_weight alone is insufficient without relaxing acceleration penalty.
failed_approaches.reason: Acceleration penalty dominated

failed_approaches.description: Adaptive symmetric entry/exit offsets (0.25-1.0m).
failed_approaches.lesson: Wide offset ranges distort waypoint geometry.
failed_approaches.reason: Offset geometry misalignment

failed_approaches.description: Asymmetric offsets (entry 0.4-0.6m, exit 0.4-0.2m).
failed_approaches.lesson: Short segments near gate centers cause L-BFGS to over-slow.
failed_approaches.reason: Short segments slowed L-BFGS optimization

failed_approaches.description: L-BFGS curvature-speed penalty using waypoint-level turn angles.
failed_approaches.lesson: Waypoint-level angles are diluted by entry/exit points.
failed_approaches.reason: Penalty too broad or too weak

failed_approaches.description: time_weight increased from 2.0 to 2.5 in L-BFGS.
failed_approaches.lesson: L-BFGS is sensitive to time_weight — higher weight redirects convergence.
failed_approaches.reason: L-BFGS converged to worse local minimum

failed_approaches.description: Drag compensation (Faessler 2018): drag_coefficient * vel added to accel_des.
failed_approaches.lesson: Cancelling drag on CURRENT velocity removes beneficial velocity damping.
failed_approaches.reason: Sim drag provides free velocity damping that helps controller

failed_approaches.description: FOV relaxation with 10% total cap.
failed_approaches.lesson: Helix section needs substantial time inflation for PD controller.
failed_approaches.reason: Helix gates need more inflation than 10% allows

failed_approaches.description: Reference-velocity drag feedforward. Tested vff=0.1, 0.15, 0.5. All regressed.
failed_approaches.lesson: Velocity feedforward is mathematically correct at steady state but helix is all transients.
failed_approaches.reason: Helix is transient-dominated; velocity FF increases overshoot at turns.

failed_approaches.description: Gain scheduling (curvature-based and error-based) in kinematic sim. 16+ configs tested.
failed_approaches.lesson: Gain scheduling fundamentally doesn't work in kinematic sim without attitude dynamics.
failed_approaches.reason: No attitude dynamics in kinematic sim. Trajectory optimizer non-determinism.

failed_approaches.description: Racing line offset=0.6 with smoothness_weight=0.3 (fast basin).
failed_approaches.lesson: The racing line L-BFGS has two distinct local minima: fast (high tracking error) and smooth (low error).
failed_approaches.reason: Fast trajectory creates untrackable curvature in helix

failed_approaches.description: Uniform time compression (3-15% compression of all segments).
failed_approaches.lesson: Compression must be segment-selective — turn segments are at their dynamic limits.
failed_approaches.reason: Turn segments at acceleration limits prevent any uniform speedup

failed_approaches.description: Polynomial curvature for TOPP speed profiling.
failed_approaches.lesson: Polynomial curvature is timing-dependent. Use waypoint Menger curvature instead.
failed_approaches.reason: Polynomial curvature at slow timing gives near-zero values

failed_approaches.description: Curvature-dependent compression floors (0.65 straights / 0.80 turns) for TOPP retimer.
failed_approaches.lesson: Curvature-dependent floors are too conservative. Uniform floor is better.
failed_approaches.reason: Produced only 14.30s vs 13.50s with uniform 0.65 floor

failed_approaches.description: a_centripetal reduction (10.0 to 9.0) in TOPP retimer.
failed_approaches.lesson: max_compression floor is the binding constraint, not curvature-based speed limits.
failed_approaches.reason: max_compression floor is binding constraint

failed_approaches.description: Compression floor alone (0.68→0.60 for easy segments) only saved 0.01s race time.
failed_approaches.lesson: Compression floor is NOT the primary binding constraint for race time.
failed_approaches.reason: L-BFGS already produces near-optimal times for straight segments; floor rarely binds

failed_approaches.description: max_compression_easy=0.50 caused gate-2 to regress 24% (exceed 20% threshold).
failed_approaches.lesson: Gate-2 has moderate curvature that isn't classified as S-turn or high-curvature, but its approach speed is sensitive to compression.
failed_approaches.reason: Gate-2 approach speed too high, 24% tracking regression

failed_approaches.description: Composite score weight tuning (tested 0.5/0.2/0.3, 0.55/0.25/0.2, 0.6/0.3/0.1) — all produce identical selection due to bipartite candidate pool.
failed_approaches.lesson: When candidates are bipartite, weight tuning is futile.
failed_approaches.reason: Bipartite pool: all non-zero time weights select Basin A (fast)

failed_approaches.description: Full-error ILC (modify trajectory positions + recompute FD derivatives). Race time 14.02→29.32s.
failed_approaches.lesson: Along-track error component shifts entire trajectory forward. Only correct cross-track error.
failed_approaches.reason: Along-track correction changes timing relationship between position and velocity

failed_approaches.description: Cross-track ILC with finite-difference recomputed derivatives. Avg error +9%, gate-2 +48%.
failed_approaches.lesson: FD-computed velocity/acceleration from shifted positions introduces noise that corrupts feedforward control.
failed_approaches.reason: Finite-difference noise corrupts feedforward signal

failed_approaches.description: Per-section ILC with higher alphas (0.5/0.6). Race time 14→27s due to offset saturation.
failed_approaches.lesson: Higher alpha causes cumulative offset to saturate at 0.375-0.45m. Keep alpha ≤0.4.
failed_approaches.reason: Cumulative offset saturation at higher alpha

failed_approaches.description: Blending at per-section ILC boundaries (linear weight ramp over 50 steps).
failed_approaches.lesson: Near-zero offset gap from weight ramp. Hard concatenation works fine with sigma=10 smoothing.
failed_approaches.reason: Near-zero gap from weight ramp caused worse results than hard boundary

failed_approaches.description: Per-section convergence tracking (each section converges independently).
failed_approaches.lesson: S-turn section converges after only 1 iteration, reducing corrections.
failed_approaches.reason: S-turn converges too quickly, stopping learning prematurely

failed_approaches.description: Butterworth Q-filter at cutoffs > 1.5 Hz. All regressed avg error.
failed_approaches.lesson: Optimal ILC bandwidth matches spatial frequency of systematic error (~0.35 Hz).
failed_approaches.reason: Avg error regressed 0.3-3.5% at cutoffs > 1.5 Hz

failed_approaches.description: Extended inflection boundaries (1.5-5.0s) for per-section bandwidth.
failed_approaches.lesson: Section boundaries that cut across gate approach zones cause regression.
failed_approaches.reason: Crossing gate-1/gate-2 boundary corrupted corrections

failed_approaches.description: Inflection cutoff > 0.60 Hz provides negligible gate-3 improvement.
failed_approaches.lesson: Per-section structure matters more than exact cutoff.
failed_approaches.reason: Gate-3 at 0.222m regardless of cutoff; higher cutoffs worsen gate-4

failed_approaches.description: Aggressive combined inflation+TOPP reductions. Race time exploded to 26.82s.
failed_approaches.lesson: Parameter changes >3% per factor cause racing line basin switching.
failed_approaches.reason: Racing line basin switching

failed_approaches.description: 2% per-parameter inflation reduction. Race time exploded to 26.81s.
failed_approaches.lesson: Even 2% TOPP floor change triggers basin switching at current values.
failed_approaches.reason: Basin switching at 2% TOPP floor

failed_approaches.description: End speed increase 0.65→0.70 had zero effect.
failed_approaches.lesson: Curvature-based speed limits dominate end speed factor.
failed_approaches.reason: End speed factor doesn't bind

failed_approaches.description: frozen_inflation decoupling. Still caused 26.81s race time.
failed_approaches.lesson: The trajectory ITSELF is untrackable at 2% more aggressive parameters.
failed_approaches.reason: Trajectory untrackable even with correct racing line

failed_approaches.description: Adaptive gate offsets (4 variants). ALL caused racing line basin switching.
failed_approaches.lesson: ENTRY_EXIT_OFFSET is globally coupled through _select_by_sim(). Even +0.02m triggers basin switching.
failed_approaches.reason: Racing line _select_by_sim() exquisitely sensitive to geometry changes

failed_approaches.description: Inflation reduction round 3 (6 params at ~1% each). Non-reproducible.
failed_approaches.lesson: Near-equal-energy basins produce non-deterministic outcomes. Verify from clean state.
failed_approaches.reason: Non-deterministic basin selection

failed_approaches.description: Gate-7 lateral offset change (0.555→0.6) triggers basin switching in full pipeline.
failed_approaches.lesson: Even small gate-7 offset changes cause trajectory optimizer basin switching. Gate-7 is at a basin boundary.
failed_approaches.reason: Basin switching — race time exploded to 27.22s

failed_approaches.description: Gate-8 vertical offset change (-0.067→0.333) triggers basin switching in full pipeline.
failed_approaches.lesson: Vertical offset changes have stronger coupling to trajectory shape than expected. Only lateral offsets at specific values are safe.
failed_approaches.reason: Basin switching — race time exploded to 27.31s

failed_approaches.description: Gate-8 lateral offset -0.6→-0.2 caused massive hidden regression (0.185→0.600m avg error).
failed_approaches.lesson: ALWAYS validate with full benchmark, not simplified sim.
failed_approaches.reason: Full benchmark shows 0.600m avg error

failed_approaches.description: More ILC iterations (5→8). Avg error 0.185→0.703m, race time 27s.
failed_approaches.lesson: ILC offsets accumulate over iterations. Larger offsets destabilize the PD controller.
failed_approaches.reason: Cumulative ILC offsets too large for PD controller

failed_approaches.description: Curvature-proportional helix inflation (10-15% based on turn angle). No effect.
failed_approaches.lesson: TOPP floor overrides inflation.
failed_approaches.reason: TOPP floor is binding constraint, not inflation

failed_approaches.description: TOPP helix curvature boost 1.15→1.25. No effect.
failed_approaches.lesson: When TOPP floor is binding, curvature boost has zero effect.
failed_approaches.reason: TOPP floor is binding constraint, not speed limit

failed_approaches.description: Joint S-turn/helix floor optimization. All 10 joint combinations tested.
failed_approaches.lesson: Asymmetric curvature sensitivity makes joint optimization unfavorable.
failed_approaches.reason: Asymmetric curvature sensitivity

failed_approaches.description: Full feedforward (ff>=0.52) causes catastrophic tracking failure in kinematic sim.
failed_approaches.lesson: Kinematic sim drag model creates narrow stability window for feedforward: ff=0.48-0.50 only.
failed_approaches.reason: Drag model feedback loop

failed_approaches.description: Higher kp (8-12) without proportional kd increase causes gate-3 S-turn oscillation.
failed_approaches.lesson: Must maintain damping ratio >= 0.8.
failed_approaches.reason: Underdamped oscillation at S-turn

failed_approaches.description: ILC gain synchronization (match ILC inner sim to benchmark: kp=7,kd=5.5,ff=0.50). Avg error regressed +15.1%.
failed_approaches.lesson: ILC corrections calibrated for OLD dynamics. The 'mismatch' is beneficial.
failed_approaches.reason: ILC corrections optimized for old dynamics

failed_approaches.description: Lookahead reduction (0.05→0.00-0.04s). Zero effect.
failed_approaches.lesson: Min-snap polynomial acceleration changes so smoothly that 0-50ms lookahead gives identical values.
failed_approaches.reason: Trajectory acceleration too smooth for lookahead to matter

failed_approaches.description: Velocity feedforward (vff=0.1-0.5) in benchmark only. All give +9.1% regression.
failed_approaches.lesson: ILC coupling masks all controller-side changes.
failed_approaches.reason: ILC-controller coupling masks controller changes

failed_approaches.description: ILC section boundary/parameter changes. All caused 27.5s race time.
failed_approaches.lesson: ILC configuration is a fragile equilibrium.
failed_approaches.reason: Different ILC offsets destabilize tracking

failed_approaches.description: S-turn TOPP floor decrease 0.67→0.66. Basin switching.
failed_approaches.lesson: S-turn floor can only be raised (slower), not lowered.
failed_approaches.reason: Basin switching

failed_approaches.description: max_tilt_rad sweep (0.85→1.05). All identical metrics.
failed_approaches.lesson: max_tilt_rad is COSMETIC in kinematic sim.
failed_approaches.reason: Tilt clipping is cosmetic

failed_approaches.description: Compound curvature boost sweep. Pareto trade-off only.
failed_approaches.lesson: Higher boosts slow turns → lower avg error but higher race time. At Pareto frontier.
failed_approaches.reason: Pareto trade-off

failed_approaches.description: Execution-time-only velocity correction (no change to ILC inner sim). Avg error +4.8%.
failed_approaches.lesson: ILC corrections are calibrated for position-only execution. Adding velocity corrections only at runtime creates a NEW mismatch since ILC learned without them.
failed_approaches.reason: ILC learned corrections assuming no velocity correction; runtime-only addition creates mismatch

failed_approaches.description: Full (1.0x) velocity correction scaling. Gate-2 regressed 26.8%.
failed_approaches.lesson: Full velocity scaling amplifies the ILC gain mismatch at gate-2. Partial scaling (0.5x) is optimal.
failed_approaches.reason: Gate-2 regression exceeds 20% threshold at 1.0x scaling

failed_approaches.description: Pre-inflection velocity scaling > 0.0 (tried 0.1). Gate-2 regresses to 0.219m.
failed_approaches.lesson: Any velocity correction in the pre-inflection section (0-200 steps) causes gate-2 regression. Must be 0.0.
failed_approaches.reason: Gate-2 regression from even 0.1x scaling in pre-inflection

failed_approaches.description: ILC acceleration feedforward correction (d²Δp/dt²). Tested 6 configs: per-section scaling, execution-time only, post-tracker, ff_ratio compensation. All regressed 0.1-1.2%.
failed_approaches.lesson: ILC position offsets already compensate for acceleration mismatch through cross-track corrections. Adding acceleration feedforward is redundant and introduces noise. The 'beneficial mismatch' between ILC inner sim (kp=6) and benchmark (kp=7) makes the ILC offsets implicitly optimal for the mismatched system. Any change to feedforward invalidates the calibration.
failed_approaches.reason: Redundant with ILC cross-track corrections; noise from 2nd derivative; invalidates ILC calibration

failed_approaches.description: Non-helix correction cap increases (inflection 0.15→0.20, post-inflection 0.15→0.20). Both regressed gate-5.
failed_approaches.lesson: Inflection/post-inflection sections have optimal correction cap at 0.15m. Larger offsets distort the gate-5 approach.
failed_approaches.reason: Gate-5 regression (0.140→0.150 for inflection at 0.20m)

failed_approaches.description: TOPP acceleration budget increase (a_centripetal 10→11, a_longitudinal 8→9.5). Race time exploded to 26.8-26.9s.
failed_approaches.lesson: TOPP acceleration budget changes catastrophically destabilize ILC. The TOPP speed profile change alters trajectory timing enough to make ILC offsets completely invalid. Even reverting floors doesn't help — the acceleration budgets alone cause the failure.
failed_approaches.reason: Catastrophic ILC destabilization — trajectory timing mismatch

failed_approaches.description: TOPP floor reduction alone (helix 0.72→0.70, easy 0.59→0.57, protected 0.65→0.63). Only 0.05s race time improvement.
failed_approaches.lesson: TOPP compression floors are NOT the primary binding constraint for race time. Confirms iter 21 finding. L-BFGS base times and inflation define trajectory speed, not TOPP floors.
failed_approaches.reason: Marginal gain — floor rarely binds

failed_approaches.description: Centripetal inflation threshold increase (4.5→6.0). Zero effect.
failed_approaches.lesson: After iter 44's inflation halving, no turns in the current track have centripetal acceleration between 4.5-6.0 m/s². The centripetal inflation was already negligible.
failed_approaches.reason: Zero turns in affected range

failed_approaches.description: L-BFGS time_weight=2.2. Found WORSE local minimum than 2.3 — gate-3 at 0.390m, gate-4 at 0.498m.
failed_approaches.lesson: L-BFGS landscape is highly non-convex. time_weight=2.2 finds a bad minimum while 2.3 finds a good one. Non-monotonic behavior makes time_weight tuning unreliable.
failed_approaches.reason: Bad L-BFGS local minimum
